tools.name: check_claim
tools.description: Start checking one factual claim (or the main claim of a web page) against public sources. Answers at once with a checkId; the result takes about three minutes, so call get_check later. Uses one credit; the credit comes back if nothing could be checked.

tools.name: get_check
tools.description: The state of a check started with check_claim, and once it is done: the evidence status, what the sources say in their own words with links and archive links, and the full report link.
